ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, Log in button — the structural black that carries almost all interface weight

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surface background — the off-white that makes the whole feed feel like printed paper

concrete.$description: Concrete — Dividers and separator borders between feed sections

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted helper text, inactive icons, disabled state borders, timestamp labels

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary body text, icon detail strokes, post metadata

hover-mist.$description: Hover Mist — Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

verified-indigo.$description: Verified Indigo — Verified badges, inline links, outlined hover state on action buttons — the only chromatic brand color, used as a quiet signature rather than a loud accent

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Follow button, primary outlined action color, clickable link emphasis — vivid blue reserved for moments that must demand a tap

system-ui.$description: All text rendering — post bodies at 15px/400, usernames and timestamps at 13px/600, caption-sized metadata at 12px/700. System font stack keeps the feed platform-native and weight-driven hierarchy rather than size-driven hierarchy.
